proposed_widenings.name: grant_proficiency
proposed_widenings.justification: Elven Chain has an item-scoped armor-training rider that the current EffectAtom union cannot express; the passive magic-item family fits, but the second grant does not.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You are considered trained with this armor even if you lack training with Medium or Heavy armor.

notes: Authored the representable +1 AC passive grant and generated a trace successfully. The item-specific armor-training clause is omitted and documented as a surface widening. `pnpm typecheck` did not pass because of a pre-existing unrelated exhaustiveness error in src/interpreter/tracer.ts for natural_weapons/water_breathing handling.
